text.body:
|| śrīḥ || || śrīśrīnivāso vijayatetarām || mahāmahopādhyāyavidvatkesarivaiyākaraṇacakravartiśrīmuṣṇaṃ śrīsubbarāyācāryamahāśayānāṃ caritam| śrīveṅkaṭagirinilayaṃ śrīvidhibhavamukhyadevanutacaraṇam| śrīpatimamalamanantajñānāndādikaṃ bhaje śaraṇam|| 1 śrīmuṣṇasubbarāyācāryāṇāṃ budhavarābhinandyānām| vidvatkesaribirudaprakaṭitamahimaikadeśavidyānām|| 2 guṇagaṇaratnākarataḥ katipayaratnāni tāvadādāya| sujanagrīvābharaṇaṃ hāraṃ racayāmi kaṃ ca modāya|| 3 kṣetraṃ śrīmanmadhvācāryā''dṛtamasti bhārate khaṇḍe| śrīmuṣṇasaṃjñamindhe makarīpatraṃ yaduñcabhūgaṇḍe|| 4 nityasarovaratīre muktasurādhīśamṛṣṭasopāne| bhaktahitāya virājati yatra harissūkaro hṛtājñāne|| 5 āryagaṇanutaguṇāryā cāryagurūttaṃsavaṃśamuktābhaḥ| nārāyaṇāryanāmā tatrābhūtpaṇḍiteḍyaśubhacaryaḥ|| 6 tattanayāḥ pañcāsan prāptanayāśśabdatantraniṣṇātāḥ| āloḍitavedāntā haricaraṇasarojamadhukarasvāntāḥ|| 7 pārtha iva madhyamo'bhūt teṣu śrīsubbarāyabudhavaryaḥ| sukṛtabharitāmbujāmbāgarmādiva candramāḥ payorāśeḥ|| 8 pitropanīta eva dvitrairabdairavāpa sadvidyām| tiruvālūrugrāme mātulasadane sthito'dhyagīṣṭa ṛcaḥ|| 9 janakājjyeṣṭhabhrātuḥ kāvyagranthānadhītya medhāvī| yatra śrīvārṣṇeyaḥ saha rukmiṇyā virājate devaḥ|| 10 mannāruguḍikṣetre niksaṃstatrādṛto budhaissarvaiḥ| paṇḍitavaryāttatra ca gopālācāryanāmakāddhīraḥ|| 11 śābde tantre kaustubhakaumudyāvadhyagīṣṭa guruṇā'tha| 'śāstreṣu bhavānnipuṇo bhavite'ti kṛtāśiṣaṃ gṛhītvā'yam|| 12 kanyāmanavadyāṅgīmanukūlāmudavahacchubhācārām| ṣaścāduttaradeśe surapuranagaraṃ caran samāsādya|| 13 eṣa hayagrīvāryādbudhavaryācchekharādikānnipuṇam| katicidadhītya granthān tadanujñātastaduttare deśe|| 14 yatra ca bhīmākūle viṭhṭhalanāmā hariḥ paro jayati| paṇḍhrāpuranāmavarakṣetraṃ bhaktyā tatassamāpede|| 15 tatra hi kṛṣṇācāryaṃ viduṣāṃ varyaṃ samāśrayaddhīmān| bhāṣyaṃ pradīpasahitaṃ bhūṣaṇasārau tathaiva maññūṣām|| 16 udyotaṃ samadhītya ca śābde tantre'bhavanmahāprājñaḥ| sa tu paśyanguruvaryoṃ vaiduṣyaṃ vāvadūkatāmasya|| 17 "mānyo bhavāṃstu bhavitā sabhāsu sarvāsu bhūpatipramukhaiḥ"| āśiṣamevamavādīt jagrāhāsau praṇāmapūrvaṃ tām|| 18 kolhāpurasaṃsthānaṃ prāyacchiṣyairayaṃ ca padacārī| yatra hi lakṣmīrvilasati kāmitasakalārthadā svabhaktebhyaḥ|| 19 nagare tasminnivasannabhyāsthannyāyaśāstramapi sakalam| śrībhikkuśāstrivaryātpaṇḍitagaṇamaulimaṇḍanoñcamaṇeḥ|| 20 tasminneva pure raghunāthābhidhatārkikaṃ jigāyā'sau| yo nyāyaratnanāmnīṃ vyākhyāmakaroddhi pañcavādānām|| 21 tatratyānāṃ viduṣāṃ pramodamudapādayatparaṃ vāgmī| āgacchan svaṃ deśaṃ maisūrupuraṃ kramādayaṃ prāpya|| 22 tatrā''sthāne viduṣo lebhe jitvoñcamānanāṃ nṛpateḥ| dakṣiṇadeśe rājannūtanadurgākhyapuranarendrasya|| 23 āsthānavibudha kuppusvāmivarādāpa pūrvamīmāṃsām| ātmakulakṣīrāmbudhirākācandro budhendranutamedhāḥ|| 24 yo'dhyāpayatsuśiṣyañchrīpūrṇaprajñaśāstratattvārthān| bahukṛtvaḥ suguṇanidhī rāmaṇṇācāryanāmaguruvaryaḥ|| 25 tasmādguruvaryādayamāmnāyāntaṃ samadhyagīṣṭa ciram| paścimajaladhestīre puryāṃ śrīrajatapīṭhasaṃjñāyām|| 26 śrīpūrṇaprajñamunipramukhārcitakṛṣṇapūjakā'graṇyāt| śrīkṛṣṇāpuramaṭhapatiyatikulatilakādavāpa parivadyām|| 27 vidyādhīśadyumaṇeravaśiṣṭāṃ śiṣyadīptihṛtatamasaḥ| evaṃ śāstreṣvasadṛśamedhāpratibhābalena deśeṣu|| 28 vidvadvaradikkariṇaḥ sadā'vajānan cacāra budhasiṃhaḥ| grāmavare kvacideṣa hi bheje samamāsanaṃ mahāsadasi|| 29 budharājaśāstriṇātha tu vāde taṃ cāparāñjigāya budhān| tañjāpure mahīpatisadasi vipaścitparīkṣakaḥra kaścit|| 30 enaṃ śāstravicāre nipuṇaṃ jñātvā'pi nā''dyakakṣyāyām| samajīgaṇattadā'yaṃ kupitaḥ purato vibhossabhāmadhye|| 31 asmin vidvatsadasi prabhavati ko vā parīkṣituṃ māṃ tu| dātuṃ vā prativacanaṃ matpraśnānāmitīrayāñcakre|| 32 atha vidvān prabhuṇoktaḥ kimetaditi taṃ parīkṣako bhītaḥ| prāmādiko'parādho mamāyamarhaḥ sumānane prathamam|| 33 vicikitsā nāstīti prāha prathamāmayaṃ tadā pūjām| lebhe sakalā lokā vismayamānandamāpuramitamaho|| 34 tatraivātha kadācit dakṣiṇadeśyā vipaścito bahavaḥ| sammantrya kuppusvāmyayyaṅgāraṃ mahoddhataṃ sadasi|| 35 tārkikarājaṃ jetuṃ pracodayāmāsurenamatidhīram| vyutpattivādanāmni granthe tamayaṃ jigāya vādeṣu|| 36 jayinamatha subbarāyācāryaṃ sarve mahāśayāstatra| suragurumaparaṃ matvā vyājahruścakravartinaṃ viduṣām|| 37 amunaivā'tiviśuddhā bhuvamiva gaṅgā bhagīrathenādau| dakṣiṇakakubhamapūrvā śābdī vidyā sthiraṃ samāninye|| 38 deśeṣu yeṣu yeṣu prakhyātatarā lasanti cedānīm| vyākaraṇaśāstrapāraṅgatāḥ sabhā''sthānapaṇḍitā jayinaḥ|| 39 vādeṣu samyagadhyāpaneṣu ca prathitaśemuṣīmahitāḥ| dadhati ca mahāmahopādhyāyopapadaṃ ca jārjinṛpadattam|| 40 śālāsu rājakīyāsvagryāsu ca paṇḍitā virājante| te sarve'pi budhendrāḥ śāstre śiṣyapraśiṣyatacchiṣyāḥ|| 41 evaṃ jaiminigautamatantre'pyanye vasanti vidvāṃsaḥ| bahavaścetyasya mahābhāgyaṃ śaknoti ko'nu varṇayitum|| 42 rājamahendre nagare śrīsatyadhyānatīrthagurusadasi| vaiyākaraṇamahebho mattastatrā''jagāma budhakariṇaḥ|| 43 durbhedacodyadantaprahārato'drāvayada drutaṃ sakalān| budhasiṃhaṃ guruvaryeṇā''hūtamimaṃ vilokya sa tu vādī|| 44 bhītatamo budhavaryaṃ praṇamya madhyesabhaṃ ca sa prāha| "etaistatrabhavadbhirvādaṃ kartuṃ kṣameta ko vādī||" 45 ete jagati mahāntaḥ pāṇinirathavā patañjalirbrāhmī| atra sabhāyāmetairadyāhaṃ vijita eva budhavaryaiḥ"|| 46 eko jigāya nikhilān pārthathaḥ saṃśaptakānivāśu sudhīḥ| bhīmaḥ krodhavaśāniva vādīndrāneka eva dhībalataḥ|| 47 svayamanviṣyāhūya prathitoddhatacaṇḍapaṇḍitapravarān| niśśaṅkaṃ dhīramatiḥ sa śapathamakarodvibhinnamadadaṃṣṭrān|| 48 durvādīndramahārathayūthe prakṣipati bhīṣaṇaśataghnīm| durbhedacodyarūpāṃ mumoca tūrṇaṃ vibhīḥ sahasraghnīm|| 49 punarapi maisūrupure rājā'mātyairasau samāhūtaḥ| viduṣastatra vijitya prāpa ca dattaṃ parīkṣakasthānam|| 50 vahudeśāgataviduṣaḥ parīkṣya nṛpatiṃ tu toṣayāmāsa| nṛpasacivairbudharājo vidhuṣāmagre supūjitaścaiṣaḥ|| 51 sadasi baroḍānṛpateḥ paṇḍitasiṃhāṃsatdātanāntsarvān| jitvā'khilaśāstreṣu prāthamikīṃ prāpa mānanāṃ śreṣṭhām|| 52 śrīpadbhanābhapādāṅguṣṭhanakhadyotadhūtasantamase| dakṣiṇavāridhitīragakeraladeśeṣu rājamāne'sau|| 53 nagare'pyanantaśayane rājasabhāyāṃ vijitya budhamallān| sauvarṇakaṭakūparvāṃ lebhe sambhāvanāṃ parāṃ prathamām|| 54 śrīveṅkaṭagirinikaṭe rājati padbhavatīvarakṣetre| śrīpūrṇaprajñamatā'valambisujanaiḥ prakalpitāyāṃ tu|| 55 siddhāntonnāhinyāṃ susabhāyāṃ prājñavaryakalitāyām| prathamaṃ parīkṣakapadaṃ pariṣkaroti sma budhavaravyūhe|| 56 cittūru kalekaṭaragryaḥ prasamīkṣya kṛtīḥ pramodato hyasya| sūtrārthamañjarīmukhaśāstragranthāṃścirādabhinananda|| 57 svābhiprāyanivedanapūrvaṃ rājñe svayaṃ nivedyāsmai| śrījārjicakravartiprabhuto varṣāśanena mahitatamam|| 58 birudaṃ mahāmahopādhyāyākhyātaṃ pradāpayāmāsa| nāmedaṃ dattamiti ḍillīnagarānnivedayāmāsa|| 59 nayaśabdaśāstrapārāvārā'ntastalavihārimatitimirāṭ| lakṣmīsarasvatībhyāṃ premṇā yaścāśrito'dhikaspardham|| 60 yatpura 'to'haṃ budha'iti bibhyati nāmāpi vaktumakhilāśca| koñcīdeśanṛpālaḥ kavikathakaiḥ kītyamānasatkīrtiḥ|| 61 asya samīkṣya pratibhāmasamādheyeṣu codyagahaneṣu| vismitamanāḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ prādādasmai suvarṇakaṭakādīn|| 62 vārāṇasyāṃ paṇ‍ḍitavādasabhāyāṃ mahāśayāssarve| nirupamapūrvantvanaghaṃ vaiduṣyaṃ śabdaśāstravārāśeḥ|| 63 jānanto'dbhutamodāmbudhau nimagnā viteruranvartham| vaiyākaraṇanṛkesaribirudaṃ saṃpūjyaṃ vibudhavarasadasi|| 64 yatra haraḥ praṇatānāmārtiharo'smīti tādṛgabhidhānaḥ| vilasati śivayā dharmā''saṃvardhinyākhyayā saha prītaḥ|| 65 śrīpañcanadakṣetre kāverītoyavātahṛtadurite| adhyāpayannavātsīcchiṣyagaṇaṃ sarvaśāstramaniśamasau|| 66 asya tu vidvān tanayaḥ śubhavṛttaḥ setumādhavābhikhyaḥ| tirupatināmni prathite kṣetravare śrīpateḥra sukhāvāse|| 67 śrīveṅkaṭeśasaṃskṛtavidyānilaye paraṃ cirāllasati| pāṇinitantre mukhyādhyāpakapadavīmavāpa medhāvān|| 68 śrīveṅkaṭanāmagirerupatyakāyāṃ vibhāsitaṃ pūtam| sākaṃ tirupatinagaraṃ priyaputreṇā'dhyuvāsa caiṣa budhaḥ|| 69 tatrāyaṃ cirakālaṃ svayamapi śiṣyān bahūni śāstrāṇi| adhyāpayannatoṣayadacyutamatirthīśca pūjyayantsatatam|| 70 sūtrārthamaṇimayī yā mañjaryamunā kṛtā budhendreṇa| sā mudritā sutenā''driyate sarvaiśśirobhirapi hṛdayaiḥ|| 71 gītābhāṣyavyākhyā śekharayugalasya cottame vyākhye| amunā vyaraciṣatemāstāśca sutenā'dya mudraṇe nihitāḥ|| 72 deśe deśe bahavo vasanti śiṣyāḥ praśiṣyavargyāśca| tannāmāni viśiṣya jñātuṃ vaktuṃ na śaknumo'dya vayam|| 73 atha vakṣyāmasteṣu ca katipayaviduṣāṃ tu nāmadheyāni| pañcanade nṛpasaṃskṛtaśālādhyakṣaśca śabdaniṣṇātaḥ|| 74 mahitanadītīrakule sañjātaḥ śiṣyarkyanutasuguṇaḥ| śrīsetumādhavāryastacchiṣyeṣu pradhānaśiṣyo'sau|| 75 vidvanmaṇighanapāṭhī śatāvadhānī vicitrakavivaryaḥ| kadalīkandānvayajo gītopanyāsilakṣmaṇācāryaḥ|| 76 asyaiva mukhyaśiṣyaḥ śābde tantre tathaiva vedānte| asmādadhītya sarvaṃ śāstraṃ śābdaṃ babhūva medhāvī|| 77 gopālaśāstrināmā pāṇinitantrajñapaṇḍitapravaraḥ| yatra ca vṛṣākapāyyornāthau devau varapradau jayataḥ|| 78 tatra tu bahavo vidyāśālāḥ kṣetre cidambare santi| vidyālaye pradhāne prathamādhyāpakapade niyukto'bhūt|| 79 tasmātpāṇinitantre santyābhāṣyantvadhītino bahavaḥ| tatraikaśchātravaro vidvāna śrīdaṇḍapāṇiyajvā yaḥ|| 80 aṇṇāmalaisarvakalāśālāsaṃskṛtabudhāgraṇīrvasati| birudaṃ mahāmahopādhyāyākhyātaṃ cidambare bibhrat|| 81 so'pi budhaḥ sacchātraḥ praśiṣyavargyo hi kulapaterasya| yo'nantaśayanasaṃskṛtaśālāpadaśāstrapaṇḍitapravaraḥ|| 82 śrīrāmakṛṣṇaśāstrī so'pi hi śiṣyo'sya bodhakalpataroḥ| adhivasati kumbhaghoṇaṃ yo'bhinavo bhaṭṭabāṇa iti viditaḥ|| 83 nagaravarakumbhaghoṇe rājantyāṃ rājakīyaśālāyām| vidvān mahāmahopādhyāyopapadaḥ kavīndrakulatilakaḥ|| 84 so'pi ca vaiyākaraṇaḥ śiṣyo hyasyaiva kṛṣṇamācāryaḥ| yaḥ śrīmahāmahopādhyāyo vīśrīnivāsabudhavaryaḥ|| 85 triśiraḥ pure'tiramye śrīraṅgakṣetraparisare deśe| josaphrakālejivare'marabhāṣā'dhyāpakaḥ praśiṣyo'sya|| 86 yo rājakīyaśālāsaṃskṛtabhāṣābudhaḥ punānagare| kāvyaprakāśaṭīkākāro'laṅkāraśābdatattvajñaḥ|| 87 jhalakīkaropanāmā vāmanabhaṭṭaḥ sa śiṣya evāsya| solāpure'sya vidvān śiṣyo govindaśāstryapi prajñaḥ|| 88 uktamidamudāharaṇaṃ na tu saṅkhyānaṃ gurośca śiṣyāṇām| vyutpattivādamasmādadhijagire tārkikā budhā bahavaḥ|| 89 ahamapi kaścana śiṣyastrayyante tviti vadāmi jihremi| gaṇanantu veditavyaṃ guruvarakaruṇā'bhilāṣayā hi param|| 90 nigamāntāgamacarcāvyāpāreṇaiva yāpayantsamayam| grahavahnivasuniśākarasaṅkhyāte śālivāhanasya śake|| 91 śrīkālayuktivatsarakārtikāsitatrayodaśīṃ yāvat| alamayamakarottirupatinagaraṃ puṇyoñcayotthayā mūrttyā|| 92 duritapraśamanamasya smaraṇaṃ sarvasya sarvabhadrāṇām| karaṇamiti bhaktinunnaḥ kiñcidavocaṃ gurośca mahimānam|| 93 śrīveṅkaṭeśavidyāśālāyāṃ śrīpade pure bhāntyām| trayyantopādhyāyaḥ śiṣṭatamaśrīnivāsabudhasūnuḥ|| 94 kadalīkandānvayajo giridharanāmā tu sāhitīvidvān| racayitvemāṃ sukṛtiṃ samarpya gurave praṇaumi guruvaryam|| 95 padmāvatīsametaḥ karuṇāvārāṃnidhī rameśo me| śrīveṅkaṭagirinilayaḥ prīto bhavatu priyaṃ ca dadātu śivam|| 96 gaganarttuvasuniśākarasaṅkhyāte śālīvāhanasya śake| bahudhānyacaitrapaurṇamyāmeṣā svāryagā kṛtirvyaraci|| 97 śrīmatāṃ ācāryāṇāṃ stutiḥ śrīmān śrīpūrṇabodhaḥ punarapi jananaṃ prāpa kiṃ veti mānyaḥ śiṣyairagryairasaṅkhyaiḥ gṛhibhirapi tathā jñānibhiḥ sevitāṅghriḥ| āryācāryaḥ sucaryaḥ prathitagururabhūdyo'śrutagranthavaktā vaṃśe tasyaiva jātaḥ sa iti bahumataṃ subbarāyāryamīḍe||1|| vyākhyāprakhyātanāmno varapavanakalāśāstrasaṅghasya nityaṃ rāmaṇṇācāryavaryādadhigatanigamāntastathā śikṣitārthaḥ| yogīndrānamyakṛṣṇāpuramaṭhayatibhirbhātavidyāmarīcī rundhan yo'bhāttamo'ntargurumakhilasatāṃ subbarāyāryamīḍe||2|| yenaivākāri yatnādiha bhuvi mahataḥ svardhunīvāmalāgryā vīdyā śābdī samagrā viharaṇamuditā sarvataścāpyapūrvā| pāyaṃpāyaṃ budhendrāḥ katipayapṛṣataḥ sarva ete hi tṛptāḥ yadvidyādevanadyāḥ guruvaramaniśaṃ subbarāyāryamīḍe||3|| śābdīvidyābhidhānāssuravarataravassanti ye yatra yatra yāvantaḥ patrapuṣpottamaphalarucirāssarva ete'pi sākṣāt| yenaivoptaissubījaissphuṭalasadupadeśābhidhaissaṃprarūḍhāḥ tajjāḥ kecittu tajjāḥ para iti mahitaṃ subbarāyāryamīḍe||4|| rājñastañjāpure yassadasi viracitaṃ prāśnikaikārhamādyaṃ prāptaḥ pīṭhaṃ parīkṣāsamaya iha bhavān sthātumarho'dya neti| proktaḥ prājñaistadā tānapi budhakariṇassarvaśāstreṣu jitvā tasthau tatraiva pīṭhe sthiramatulamatiṃ subbarāyāryamīḍe||5|| medhāṃ vāde yadīyāṃ budhamadaśamanīṃ sarvaśāstrapravīṇaḥ śrutvā vādāya nāgāt kvacidatha haṭhato nirjito māyirājaḥ| yenānyo'pītthamevādhikabhayavivaśaḥ nyāyaraṅgapravīṇaḥ nā'dādvyutpattivāde prativacanamaho subbarāyāryamīḍe||6|| jārjiśrīcakravartī nikhilabudhanutāṃ sarvadeśaprasiddhāṃ prajñāṃ kīrtiṃ niśamyādhikamuditamanāḥ mānayāmāsa samyak| datvā bhūṣāṃ suvarmādikamapi birudaṃ sārthakaṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ varṣe varṣe śataṃ śrīpatipadanirataṃ subbarāyāryamīḍe||7|| śrīsatyajñānatīrthavrativarasadasi prauḍhavādīndrabhīme prāptaṃ dṛptaṃ vipaścidgajamadhikabalākṣepadantaprahāraiḥ| prājñān dūre kṣipantaṃ prativacanamahākuntabhagnaṃ vyadhādyaḥ sadyovidyotabodhaḥ pratibhaṭabhadaḥ subbarāyāryamīḍe||8|| baddhā yenātiśuddhā'bhinavabahutarākṣepavikṣepadakṣā śikṣāyāṃ copayuktā paṭumatividuṣāṃ bālakānāṃ ca samyak| arthānāṃ sūtrabhāṣyapratipadalasatāṃ dhīmatāṃ karṇabhūṣā'ñabhikhyāṃ sūtrārtharatnojjvalatanuratulāṃ vindate mañjarīyam||9|| yasmin vidvanmṛgendre viharati nṛpatiprauḍhasaṃsadvanāntaḥ procurnaikaṃ ca śabdaṃ kila cakitatarāśśābdikākhyā madebhāḥ| dustarkakrūradaṃṣṭrā api bhayavivaśāstārkikadvīpisaṅghāḥ līnāḥ kutrāpi noñcairdhvanimapi sasṛjustāntrikavyālayūthāḥ||10|| satsvapyanyeṣu kānteṣvanupamamaniśaṃ prema yatraiva cakre vādīndrairdhārtarāṣṭraiḥ kṛtavividhamahābhaṅgato mocitā''sīt| vīrāgryeṇaiva yenānavaratamuditā madhvasiddhāntavidyā pāñcālīva svaśāstre sa diśatu sumatiṃ subbarāyāryabhīmaḥ||11|| āsīdāryārthanīyā śucitamaparibhāṣopanāmendumauleḥ mūrtiryā viśvavadyābhilaṣitasakalārthapradā durgamā ca| jñaptyai tasyāssukhenārthiṣu parakṛpayā'nalpamodāya teṣāṃ vyākhyā divyāñjanābhā vyaraci kila subodhinyāhvayā yena ramyā||12|| vādeṣvāsetuhaimācalamiha na jito yena nāsīdvipaścit ko'pi kvāpi prabhūtāgrahavivaśabudhaiḥ dūṣaṇaudhe prayukte| udvego naiva cintā na matikaluṣatā na pramādo na yasya protthā saurāpageva prativacanatatiḥ kevalaṃ yanmukhādreḥ||13|| śrīmaccheṣācaleśāṅghrijalayugalā''lokanotkaṇṭhitān yaḥ prāptān śrāntān dvijāgryān satanayavanitānādareṇānnadānaithaḥ| bhogairabhyaṅgapūrvairasukhayadadhikaṃ śrīpadāhve pure sve putre vidvadvare'dhyāpayati padakalāṃ subbarāyāryamīḍe||14|| yasmānmerorivādrervarabahukṛtayo nirgatā devanadyaḥ cetastāpān samastān sakṛdapi paṭhanasnānataḥ sajjanānām| nighnantyunmūlayanti pratikathakamanorūḍhagarvoñcavṛkṣān dadyācchrīsubbarāyaprathitaguruvarassa smṛto maṅgalaṃ naḥ||15|| tthaṃ śrīsubbarāyottamagurucaraṇāmbhojasaṃsaktacittaḥ mocākandānvayotthaḥ giridharasukaviḥ śrīnivāsāryaputraḥ| tasyāpārād guṇābdheḥ katipayaguṇasanmauktikāni pragṛhya tene mālāṃ svakaṇṭhe diśatu gururimāṃ saṃvahan sanmatiṃ me||16||
śrīḥ śrīnivāso vijayate mahāmahopādhyāya, vidyāmārtaṇḍa, madhvasiddhāntabhūṣaṇa śrīmuṣṇaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ śrīsetumādhavācāryāṇāṃ stutiḥ lakṣmīlalākaṭākṣotpalasumanikarābaddhamugdhāśvavaktrapratyakṣodbhūtamodā'tiśayajaladhisaṃmagnaśuddhātmanāṃ yaḥ| vaṃśe haṃsottamaiḥ sadgṛhibhirapi budhaissevitānāṃ gurūṇāṃ āryācāryābhidhānāṃ jayati varajaniḥ śrīgururmauktikābhaḥ||1|| śābdī vidyā'navadyā pratidinamuditā yanmukhoñcodayādreḥ śiṣyaughasvāntadaryāśritamapi timiraṃ līlayaivāśu bhittvā| nityaṃ viṣṇoḥ padaṃ cāmalamativitataṃ bhāsayantī jayantī rājatyadyāpyavāryā taraṇighṛṇiriva śrīguruṃ taṃ samīḍe||2|| mahyāṃ santi budhāḥ paraśśatamaho naivābhijātāstu te santyanyepyabudhā mahākulabhavā hītthaṃ satāṃ mānase| yadduḥkhaṃ mahadadya yaṃ varakulotpannaṃ budhāgresaraṃ dṛṣṭvaivāpagataṃ sa me vijayate sarvābhinandyo guruḥ||3|| sadvaṃśaprabhavatvaśāstravimalaprajñāpravaktṛtvasaddharmācāradayākṣamāśamadamaśrīkāntabhaktyādayaḥ| śobhante suguṇāḥ parasparamaho prāptā mahāsauhṛdaṃ yasminneva gurussa me guṇanidhiḥ bhūtiṃ tanotvanvaham||4|| pāṇḍityaṃ kila yatnato'pi bahulaṃ prāyo bhavedvai nṛṇāṃ jātānāṃ na kadāpi satkulabhavatvaṃ syāddhi yatnoñcayaiḥ| sauvarṇasya sumasya saurabhamiva ślāghyaṃ kulīnasya sadvidyetyuktiriyaṃ samullasati yaṃ prāpyaiva taṃ sannumaḥ||5|| śrīmatpāvanapāvanāgamatativyākhyānadhārāmṛtaṃ pāyaṃpāyamapi pramodabharitāḥ śiṣyāścakorā iva| citraṃ no viramanti yasya vadanādindoścyutaṃ nirmalāt so'yaṃ me gururāṭ sadāgamaparijñānāya bhūyātsadā||6|| āryācāryamahānvāyākalaśāmbhorāśirākāpateḥ bheryārāvanighuṣṭasarvabudhasaṃmānyākhilekṣānidheḥ| vidvatkesarisubbarāyasuguroḥ sūnussudhīstatsamaḥ śiṣṭāgryo bhuvi setumādhavabudho jejīyatāṃ santatam||7|| śrītañjānagarāntike śucitame sahyādrijāyāstaṭe kṣetre pañcanadābhidhe vasumatīhāre'grahāre śubhe| jātaḥ śrīvijayodarādiva mude pūrvācalāñcandramāḥ nityaṃ candrikayā sutarpitajano jīyāñciraṃ me guruḥ||8|| śāstraṃ sarvamadhītya tātacaraṇāt saṃmānitaḥ paṇḍitaiḥ āste śiṣyakṛpārṇavaḥ padakalopādhyāyavaryaścirāt| śrīmacchrīpadapattane tviha lasacchraveṅkaṭādhīśvaradravyasthāpitasaṃskṛtottamakalāśālāṃ samudbhāsayan||9|| śābdaṃ ṣṭtriṃśadabdānakhilamapi mahābhāṣyamukhyaṃ suśāstraṃ nissandehaṃ rahasyāmitasarasalasatsaṃpradāyārthayogaiḥ| adhyāpyānekaśiṣyān prati samamakarodviśvavidyālaye'sau uttīrṇān yaḥ parīkṣāsvayamiha gururāḍrājatāṃ sūrivaryaḥ||10|| yasya śrītātapādairabhinavamatulaṃ durlabhaṃ śabdaśāstraṃ kauśeyaṃ dakṣiṇasyā vyaraci śubhatamācchādanaṃ sarvagātre| tatputreṇāmunā'dyākhilaharidabalāsundarāṅgāṇi citraṃ tattulyairuñcamūlyairvitatabahupadairaṃśukairmaṇḍitāni||11|| yenaiveyaṃ hi śālā supadakṛtamahaunnatyamāptā viśālā yasyākṛṣṭā guṇaughairjaraṭhamapi patiṃ yaṃ priyaṃ manyate sma| yatsaṃbandhāturaivā'diśadapi bhaginīṃ yasya śiṣyāya yūne so'yaṃ śreyo vidadhyāt suguṇamaṇikhaniḥ santataṃ śrīgururme||12|| śābdī bhūṣaṇasārasundaratarā sacchekharālaṅkṛtā sadbhāṣyā ca manoramādṛtavapuḥ śrīśabdaratnojvalā| mañjūṣārthayutā ca yasya vadane raṅge sphurantī rasāt nṛtyantī tanute naṭīva muditān vidyārthisāmājikān||13|| pṛthvīmaṇḍalavartipaṇḍitavaraprajñāsuvarṇoñcatā sannirṇāyakabuddhiśāṇālasitaiḥ yaḥ ślāghitaḥ santatam| satyadhyānagurūttamaiḥ pratisabhaṃ saṃmānito modataḥ taṃ vidvadvarasetumādhavaguruṃ vandāmahe śreyase||14|| saujanyaṃ śucitāṃ dayāṃ niyamane vidyārthināṃ dakṣatāṃ kāryāṇāṃ ca vivecane nipuṇatāṃ jñātvā yadīyāṃ muhuḥ| śālādhyakṣavaraścakāra kurute yaṃ svīyabhārodvahaṃ naipuṇyaṃ kavitāpathe diśatu me so'yaṃ kavīndro guruḥ||15|| yassaṃprīṇayate suśābdavacanairvidyārthinassādaraṃ miṣṭānairatithīn sadocitadhanairdīnān budhān vidyaya| bhaktyā pūjanayā ca veṅkaṭapatiṃ śrīmadhvaśāstroktibhiḥ śrīvyāsaṃ mama setumādhavaguruḥ puṣṇātu vidyāṃ parām||16|| śrīmuṣṇābhidhasaṃpradāyavarasaddharmavyavasthāpakaḥ śrīmuṣṇopapadaḥ sudhīnutamatiḥ śrīsubbarāyāryataḥ| ātreyāhvayagotradugdhajaladheḥ jātaḥ kaleśaḥ parāt asmai śrīgurave paraśśatamasāvāyurdiśatvacyutaḥ||17|| itthaṃ sarvajanānubhūtiviṣayaissañcoditassadguṇaiḥ nityaṃ tadgurubhāvano giridharasstauti priyaḥ kautukāt| asmaddeśikahṛnnivāsyamitadhīcittābjagaḥ śrīpatiḥ suprīto bhavatu śriyaṃ ca paṭhatāmāyurdhiyaṃ yacchatu||18|| śrīsetumādhavagurorguṇamaṇimālā kutūhalādracitā| giridharanāmnā kavinā kadalīkandānvavāyajanitena||19|| śrīveṅkaṭeśavidyāśālāsāhityapaṇḍitenaiṣā| śrī śrīnivāsabudhavaratanayena satāṃ cirāya bhavatu śivam||20|| iti śrīpadapurī(tirupati)virājamāna śrīveṅkaṭeśvarasaṃskṛtamahākalāśālāyāṃ sāhityapradhānādhyāpakena dvaitavedāntaniṣṇātena kadalīkandānvayajena śrīnivāsācāryaputreṇa giridharācāryeṇa raciteyaṃ gurorguṇamaṇimālā|| śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu
